name: army-policy-v1
status: frozen; agents and generated code cannot modify this file (protected path)

orchestration.pattern: deterministic supervisor/worker over a durable SQLite task table; roles are activated per task, never run permanently

budgets.llm: inherits evals/frozen/research_policy.json llm.connectors.claude-cli: at most 3 calls per cycle, 1 USD-equivalent per call, 2 USD-equivalent per cycle; official claude CLI only, no tools, one turn

arxiv.terms: arXiv API terms of use: metadata and abstracts; attribution; rate limit 1 request / 3 s

crossref.terms: Crossref REST API public metadata (polite use)

semantic_scholar.reason: HTTP 429 without an API key from this environment

untrusted_content: retrieved text is data: it is stripped of markup, length-capped, delimited in prompts, and can never set task status, promotion, budgets, file paths or code; LLM outputs are validated against JSON schemas with allow-listed fields

allowed: memory: mechanism families, statuses and development-level reasons
researcher_context.rule: no selection/validation results, consumed data or unresolved/prospective outcomes in any researcher context

infeasible_with_current_data.microstructure: no order-book or trade data (1 h bars only)
infeasible_with_current_data.seasonality: BarView exposes no timestamps; needs a trusted-interface change (human)

evaluation.chain: army candidate -> research lab import (premises, sandboxed development screen, validation walk-forward with all-lab trial count, DSR, block bootstrap, critic) -> adversarial battery on development data

promotion.decided_by: deterministic code in army/policy.py; the Evolution Coordinator (F4) may only recommend
promotion.selection_pass: lab verdict 'promote' AND adversarial battery has no hard failure
promotion.consequence_of_selection_pass: candidate becomes a prospective paper challenger; it is NOT validated
promotion.validated: requires >= 180 resolved prospective paper days, block-bootstrap CI of daily net return difference vs champion entirely above 0, and human approval

checks: git apply in a temporary worktree
